{
  "target_file": "service.py",
  "strategy": "Replace all occurrences of `yaml.load` without an explicit Loader with `yaml.safe_load`.",
  "budget_lines": 8,
  "safe_replacement_pattern": "yaml\\.load\\((.*)\\) -> yaml.safe_load(\\1)",
  "justification": "Using `yaml.load` without a safe Loader can lead to arbitrary code execution during deserialization. Switching to `yaml.safe_load` mitigates this vulnerability while preserving needed functionality for typical YAML parsing."
}
